title: Thai Chicken Curry with a German Twist
description: A unique blend of Thai spices and German beer to create a hearty and flavorful curry. Perfect for a cold winter night.

ingredients.name: Thai red curry paste
ingredients.notes: make sure to get a good quality paste for the best flavor

ingredients.name: german beer
ingredients.notes: any lager or pilsner will work, but a darker beer can add a richer flavor

ingredients.name: coconut milk
ingredients.notes: full-fat coconut milk for the best flavor

ingredients.name: fish sauce
ingredients.notes: optional, but adds a nice umami flavor

instructions: Heat the oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Add the onion and cook until it's translucent, about 5 minutes.
Add the garlic and cook for another minute.
Add the chicken and cook until it's browned on all sides, about 5-7 minutes.
Add the curry paste and cook for 1-2 minutes, until it's fragrant.
Add the beer and bring to a simmer.
Add the coconut milk, sugar, fish sauce, salt, and pepper. Stir to combine.
Reduce the heat to low and let it simmer for 20-25 minutes, or until the chicken is cooked through.
Taste and adjust the seasoning as needed.
Serve hot over rice or noodles.
Garnish with fresh cilantro or scallions, if desired.
